author: Milan Hrdlicka
text: Milan has been levelling the Ellbach bridge twice a year since 2011. We asked him why the job is still done by hand.
quote_text: The bridge moves four millimetres between February and August, and it has done that every year I have measured it. The moment I stop going out there myself, that number turns into a number somebody downloaded. Then one August it is nine millimetres and nobody can say when it started.
